title: Kinetic Pistons
description: A subtle alternative to classic piston state indicator resource packs!
body:
Uses Vanilla Tweaks assets!

![Title saying "Kinetic Pistons", sticky piston extending animation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/axialeaa/Axialeaa-BrandingAssets/refs/heads/main/RESOURCEPACKS/KineticPistons/Model/title.gif)

Kinetic Pistons is my own unique take on the classic "block state indicator" style of resource pack! It aims to complement the vanilla design while also being helpful for redstone engineers of all skill levels, distinguishing between regular and sticky pistons as well as extended and retracted states.

Shader: Mellow by TheCMK

![Sticky piston in a badlands biome](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/axialeaa/Axialeaa-BrandingAssets/refs/heads/main/RESOURCEPACKS/KineticPistons/Screenshots/badlands.png)

🤔 Uhh... This is not why I'm here!

 I mostly create mods but sometimes I dip my toes into resource packs on the side! This is the first one I'm releasing on Modrinth but there may be more to come in the future. Don't worry; I'm not going to stop making mods! Stay tuned...
